corrections.text: The article states that the Covered List update "carves out an exemption for the federal government itself, which can continue buying and using the affected devices, according to CBS News." This fact is accurate, but CBS News's report does not contain it — the CBS News article covers only the market-share and trade-policy angle. The correct source for this claim is Robotics and Automation News, which reports: "It also does not impact purchase or use by the federal government at all."
